decisions.reason: The quoted NL3 contract requires orthogonal regions permitting concurrent activation of different collision-avoidance controls. Exact source and model facts bind ActiveState to three sibling child composites, while the canonical concurrent-region count is zero and the closed hierarchy contains no explicit orthogonal or parallel partition.
